in_sanskrit.name: Rathva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rathva is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ratha' meaning chariot, and 'va' meaning 'of gods'. Thus, Rathva can be interpreted as the chariot of the gods.

in_marathi.name: Rathva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rathva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rides a chariot, often symbolizing a leader or warrior.
